title: HD-01 (THE LOVE HOODIE)
description:
Background: Ye began selling this HD-01 with the SHMG logo in support of Sean Combs, referring to a 2016 hotel surveillance video showing Sean "Diddy" Combs physically assaulting his then-girlfriend, R&B singer Cassie Ventura. The SHMG logo was used because Ventura was seen wearing a sample hoodie featuring the logo in the footage. In a tweet promoting the hoodie, Ye referred to it as "THE LOVE HOODIE".

DISCLAIMER: This record is presented for archival purposes only. yzylibrary doesn't endorse, support, or condone the actions of Sean Combs. The inclusion of this record serves solely to document Yeezy's release of the hoodie and the context of it. Because Ye's views and public positions can change over time, the context given should not be interpreted as a reflection of his current stance.
